errors.no_origin: The view shows no web page, so it has no storage to write.

errors.unsupported_engine: The storage panel reads Chromium views only for now.

panel.name: Name
panel.pinsEmpty: Nothing pinned. Pin a value to have it set again after every navigation.
panel.pinsOff: Pinned values are switched off in the settings.
panel.pinsUntrusted: Pinned values apply only in a trusted workspace; trust the workspace to use them.

mcpValues.description: Lets an AI agent read cookie and storage values through storage_get and write them through storage_set. Off by default: storage_get then answers names, attributes, lengths and which views agree, never a value, and storage_set is refused. The panel works either way.
mcpValues.help: Lets an AI agent read cookie and storage values through storage_get and write them through storage_set. Off, storage_get answers names and attributes only and storage_set is refused. The panel works either way.
mcpValues.label: Values over MCP

pinsEnabled.description: Pinned cookies and storage values are set again after every navigation, storage values before the page's own scripts run.
pinsEnabled.help: Pinned cookies and storage values are set again after every navigation, storage values before the page's own scripts run, so a feature flag survives a reload. Off ignores the pins.
pinsEnabled.label: Apply pinned values

pollMs.description: How often the open storage panel reads the views again, in milliseconds; 0 reads only on navigation and after an edit.
pollMs.help: How often the open storage panel reads the views again, in milliseconds; 0 reads only on navigation and after an edit. Example: 2000.
pollMs.label: Refresh interval

showHttpOnly.description: HttpOnly cookies appear in the panel and in storage_get (they are read through the DevTools protocol, not document.cookie).
showHttpOnly.help: HttpOnly cookies appear in the panel and in storage_get, read through the DevTools protocol. Off hides them as document.cookie would.
showHttpOnly.label: Show HttpOnly cookies

tools.get: The cookies, localStorage and sessionStorage of the targeted views as JSON (per view, Chromium views only; others are marked unsupported), with the entries that differ between the views: which views agree and which lack it. Values only while a person allows them (Settings > Storage > Values over MCP); otherwise names, attributes and lengths. Optional kinds, origin and search filter.
tools.set: Sets or deletes one cookie, localStorage or sessionStorage entry in the targeted views and answers per view success or error. A storage write goes to the views showing the given origin (default: each view's own). Refused unless a person allows values over MCP in the settings.
